methodology.notes: Custom agent scaffold: a Jizhi platform agent (scene 7953) is bridged to tau2-bench over the Channel V2 WebSocket and wrapped as a HalfDuplexAgent. Each turn the 7953 agent emits a pure JSON object ({"tool_calls":[...]} or {"message":"..."}); the adapter executes the tau2 tools locally and feeds the results back. A CONTRACT instruction block is injected ahead of the domain policy in the agent's system prompt (hence modified_prompts=true). The user simulator and NL assertions run on deepseek/deepseek-chat.

verification.details: Inject the "CONTRACT" prompt word + Jizhi 7953 Agent bridge
